learning_outcomes.text: Explain sources of bias across the AI lifecycle from data to deployment
Distinguish common fairness definitions and why they can conflict
Select and compute fairness metrics appropriate to a context
Evaluate mitigation techniques at pre-, in- and post-processing stages
Apply explainability and transparency techniques to a model's decisions
Communicate fairness trade-offs and limitations to stakeholders

integrative_case: A bank's loan-approval model shows different approval rates across groups: trace the bias sources, compare fairness definitions and show their conflict, compute metrics, choose a mitigation, and explain the trade-off to a fairness committee.
